title: Alternative-day ambiguity refreshes availability after correction
description: The caller starts with a Tuesday-or-Wednesday afternoon preference. The assistant may pick one candidate day first, but after the caller corrects to Wednesday it must issue a fresh checkAvailability call instead of reusing stale Tuesday availability.

turns.user: Chcialbym umowic pierwsza konsultacje, najlepiej we wtorek albo srode tak mniej wiecej po lunchu.

rubric.description: The assistant should issue a second availability lookup after the caller picks Wednesday.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant is not refreshing availability after the caller changes the preferred day

rubric.description: The first lookup should preserve the afternoon window.
rubric.root_cause_hint: time preference normalization drifted for phrases such as po lunchu

rubric.description: The refreshed Wednesday lookup should preserve the afternoon window.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant lost the time window after the caller corrected the day

rubric.description: The second availability request should change the requested date after the caller picks Wednesday.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant kept the stale day even after the caller corrected it

rubric.description: This ambiguity-resolution scenario must not create a booking.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant advanced into createEvent before the caller selected a slot
